notes:
**CHR-1257 — Stitch direction (phase 1, 2026-11-27; awaiting Christian's approval).** Redrawn after mockup `ui-refresh-stitch` variant `base-v2`. Everything floats on a dotted workspace (`--chrome-workspace`, dot grid `size.dot-grid`); window inset `spacing.xl` (16px) on every side.

- **Top bar** (`#topbar`, three `float-pill` groups): brand + project picker (`float-btn` `field` → open-project-dialog) | view tabs (`float-btn`, `on` = active view; Board → board-view, Design System → design-system-view, Use Cases → usecases-list, Beta badge kept from CHR-1164) | settings (`float-icon-btn`).
- **Left card** `#nav-card` (`float-card`, width `size.nav-card` 256px, full height): `seg-tabs` Screens 14 | Mockups 5, fold (`#left-header` → sidebars-collapsed), `find-field` + `tag-toggle`, screen tree `#screens-list` (`role=tree`) of `tree-row` / `tree-variant-row`; `home` is open with its four variants, `default` selected. Tags are `chrome-chip`s; the list fades out at the bottom and scrolls inside the card.
- **Tool bar** `#tool-bar` (`tool-bar`, icon-only, `role=toolbar`, vertical, `focusgroup`), top-aligned with the frame: Comment, Inspect (hover state; → inspector-selected) | Notes, Comments (badge 3; → comments-panel), Flow, Design system | More. Each tool has `aria-label`, `aria-keyshortcuts`, `title` and `interestfor`; the `hint-tooltip` on Inspect shows the 2 s interest tooltip (blue, to the right, name + key).
- **Frame**: the open screen alone at 90% (`#screen-frame`, 792×504, `radius.frame`, `shadow-frame`) with a `frame-label` (viewport icon, name, variant). The stand-in content is the user's screen: literal light values are intended drift.
- **Agent bar** `#agent-bar` (`float-card`, `size.agent-bar` 248px, full height): Live chip, `agent-status` (Writing checkout + Follow the agent switch), `section-head` Activity, feed of `agent-activity` items, `agent-note` scoped to the open screen and variant.
- **Zoom** `zoom-pill` (− 90% + | Fit), centred under the frame.

Removed with the old columns: the Context panel (Use cases / Notes / Comments sections) and the Elements panel, plus their flows `su-row-*` → usecases-detail and `el-checkout`. Notes and Comments now open from the tool bar; the CHR-1062 \"Use cases mapping to this screen\" section moves into the Notes panel in phase 2. Dark variant follows in phase 2. Decision: `chr1257-stitch-chrome`.

---
*Before CHR-1257 (superseded layout, kept for history):*

CHR-905 / CHR-909 direction C, light shell (approved by Christian 2026-10-23; folded in from the former chrome-c-shell). Root binds `--chrome-*` from `chrome-light.*`; all chrome uses `chrome-*` components and `$size/$spacing/$radius/$typography` tokens. Panels: Screens 264px (variant tree with tag chips), Context 252px (Use cases + Notes + Comments), canvas with variant breadcrumb, Elements 280px; topbar 44px.

Variants of this screen: app-shell-dark = chrome-c-shell-dark, project menu = chrome-c-shell-menu, zoom menu = chrome-c-shell-zoom-menu, offline chip = chrome-c-shell-offline, shortcuts = chrome-c-shell-shortcuts, dialogs = chrome-c-dialog (+ -dark), compare = chrome-c-compare, mockup columns = chrome-c-mockup-columns.

**CHR-1062 — Use Cases.** Fourth view tab \"Use Cases\" after Board. Reverse entry in the Context panel: a \"Use cases\" section (above Notes) lists the use cases with a step that maps to the open screen. The section is hidden when nothing maps to the screen or the project has no `usecases/` folder.

Mapping: decision chr905-preview-var-mapping; shortcuts: chr905-shortcuts.
